title: Total Coloring Conjecture
exact_target: Can the vertices and edges of every finite simple graph be colored with at most two more colors than its maximum degree, while all adjacent or incident elements get different colors?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1401 (GRAPH-014). CC BY 4.0.

Rongjin Su, Gang Fang and Enqiang Zhu, The Total Coloring Conjecture Holds for Planar Graphs Without Three Special Subgraphs, arXiv:2507.12737v1 (2025), Section 1, Conjecture 1.1, and Section 2 simple-graph convention.
